explanation: Small bumps where a pore got clogged with oil and dead skin and closed over. The white tip is the trapped material under the surface.
care_tip: Gentle exfoliating ingredients like salicylic acid help unclog pores. Do not squeeze them.

explanation: Clogged pores that stayed open. The dark color is not dirt. It is the clog reacting with air.
care_tip: Salicylic acid cleansers work well over time. Pore strips feel satisfying but the clog usually comes back.

explanation: Small firm red bumps where a clogged pore got inflamed. They have no white tip and can feel tender.
care_tip: Be gentle. Benzoyl peroxide in low strength calms them. Scrubbing makes inflammation worse.

explanation: Inflamed bumps filled with fluid. This is what most people picture when they hear pimple.
care_tip: A small dab of benzoyl peroxide helps. Popping them pushes the inflammation deeper and can scar.

explanation: Deep painful lumps under the skin. This is the most serious type and the most likely to scar.
care_tip: This type really needs a dermatologist. Home products alone usually cannot reach it.
